examples.title: Replace one file, keep everything else byte-identical

description: Edit an existing archive without recompressing anything: operations add / replace / remove / rename / setComment applied in order. mode 'append' (default) = save(): the original bytes stay verbatim and edits are appended — fast and byte-preserving, BUT removed or replaced payloads REMAIN in the file (data remanence: recoverable by anyone; a ZIP_DEAD_BYTES_RATIO diagnostic fires past 50 % dead bytes, and 7-Zip is known to read the stale payload). mode 'compact' = saveCompact(): canonical rewrite, still no recompression, removed data truly gone, SFX prefix dropped. No edits and an unchanged comment return the same bytes (`summary.noOp`). Archives with duplicate entry names are refused — prefer create_zip for a full rebuild or when the source has duplicate names. Output base64 or a sandbox file.

compression.description: Compression settings. `method` 'deflate' (default) or 'store'; `level` 0–9 (default 6); `deterministic: true` pins the pure-TS encoder so the bytes are identical on every runtime (slower).

deterministic.description: true pins the pure-TS encoder: identical bytes on every runtime (slower).

defaultDate.description: Timestamp for entries that set no `date`: an ISO-8601 instant (1980-01-01 … 2107-12-31, 2-second DOS granularity) or 'now' (wall clock — emits the ZIP_TIMESTAMP_NOT_PINNED diagnostic and makes the bytes non-reproducible). Omitted: the DOS epoch 1980-01-01T00:00:00 (reproducible).

limits.description: Override zipnative's named security bounds for this call (CWE-400 / CWE-409 guards). Every key is optional; absent keys keep the engine defaults (maxEntries 100000, maxEntryUncompressedSize 1 GiB, maxTotalUncompressedSize 8 GiB, maxCompressionRatio 1024, maxNameBytes 4096, maxExtraFieldBytes 65535, maxCommentBytes 65535, maxCentralDirectoryBytes 256 MiB). Values above the operator ceilings (ZIPNATIVE_MCP_MAX_UNCOMPRESSED_BYTES, ZIPNATIVE_MCP_MAX_ENTRIES) are refused with LIMIT_CEILING_EXCEEDED. Raise a bound for trusted input only.

maxCompressionRatio.description: Maximum declared uncompressed/compressed ratio for entries >= 1 KiB compressed (zip-bomb guard).

maxEntryUncompressedSize.description: Maximum decompressed size of one entry, bytes.

maxExtraFieldBytes.description: Maximum extra-field block length in bytes.

maxTotalUncompressedSize.description: Maximum total decompressed size across an extraction, bytes.

mode.description: 'append' (default): save() — original bytes verbatim + appended entries + new central directory; removed/replaced payloads REMAIN in the file (data remanence). 'compact': saveCompact() — canonical rewrite without recompression, removed data truly gone, SFX prefix dropped.

operations.description: Edits applied in order. add: new entry (ZIP_ENTRY_EXISTS if present); replace: existing entry (ZIP_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND otherwise); remove; rename (never overwrites: remove the target first); setComment.

compression.description: Compression settings. `method` 'deflate' (default) or 'store'; `level` 0–9 (default 6); `deterministic: true` pins the pure-TS encoder so the bytes are identical on every runtime (slower).

deterministic.description: true pins the pure-TS encoder: identical bytes on every runtime (slower).

dataBase64.description: File content as base64. Exclusive with text / sourcePath.

date.description: ISO-8601 last-modified instant for this entry, 1980-01-01 … 2107-12-31 (overrides defaultDate; 2-second DOS granularity).

directory.description: add only: an explicit directory entry.

externalAttributes.description: Raw external attributes (uint32). Exclusive with unixMode.

extraFields.description: Extra fields to embed verbatim (id 0–65535 except 0x0001, the Zip64 record the engine owns). The caller owns their determinism.

dataBase64.description: Payload bytes as base64 (may be empty).

id.description: Extra-field header id (0–65535; 0x0001 is reserved for the engine).

name.description: Entry name, '/'-separated. Directories end in '/' (or set `directory: true`).

op.description: 'add' a new entry (ZIP_ENTRY_EXISTS if present) or 'replace' an existing one (ZIP_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND otherwise).

sourcePath.description: Relative path of a file inside the ZIPNATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR sandbox to read the content from (any extension). Exclusive with dataBase64 / text.

text.description: File content as UTF-8 text. Exclusive with dataBase64 / sourcePath.

unixMode.description: Unix permission bits as 3–4 octal digits ('0644', '755', '0o755'); mapped to external attributes. Exclusive with externalAttributes.

op.description: Remove an entry (its bytes remain in the file under mode append).
Rename an entry without recompression; never overwrites an existing name.

outputMode.description: 'base64' (default) returns the bytes inline as an embedded resource (≤ 50 MiB). 'file' writes them inside ZIPNATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR (never overwrites; ≤ 4 GiB, streamed) and returns a resource_link.

outputPath.description: Relative path inside the sandbox (only when outputMode='file'); must end in a container extension (.zip recommended).

strict.description: Escalate the first engine diagnostic (prepended data, duplicate name, name mismatch, …) to a ZIP_STRICT_DIAGNOSTIC error instead of reporting it.

zipBase64.description: The archive bytes as base64 (exactly once; a data: URI prefix is tolerated). Exclusive with zipPath. Decoded size ≤ 128 MiB.

zipPath.description: Relative path of an archive inside the ZIPNATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR sandbox (no absolute paths, no '..'; container extensions only: .zip .jar .docx .epub …). Exclusive with zipBase64. Lets a create/modify → verify/extract chain avoid re-sending the bytes.

name: modify_zip

outputSchema.description: Result of an archive-producing tool. base64 mode: the archive arrives as an embedded `resource` content block (not duplicated here); file mode: `filePath` + a resource_link.

diagnosticCounts.description: Number of diagnostics received per code (counts every occurrence, including de-duplicated ones).

diagnostics.description: Non-fatal conformance concerns the engine raised while parsing or writing (de-duplicated by code + entry, at most 200). Empty for a clean archive. Codes: ZIP_PREPENDED_DATA, ZIP_MULTIPLE_EOCD, ZIP_NAME_MISMATCH, ZIP_UNICODE_PATH_CONFLICT, ZIP_INVALID_UTF8_NAME, ZIP_DUPLICATE_NAME, ZIP_EXTRA_FIELD_MALFORMED, ZIP_ZIP64_EXTRA_IGNORED, ZIP_TIMESTAMP_NOT_PINNED, ZIP_NONDETERMINISTIC_CODEC, ZIP_DEAD_BYTES_RATIO.

diagnosticsTruncated.description: Present (true) when more than 200 distinct diagnostics were dropped from `diagnostics`.

grewByBytes.description: outputBytes − inputBytes (negative after a compacting rewrite).

noOp.description: true when the engine returned the input buffer unchanged (no pending edit, same comment).
